articles.headline: How active NFL players continue to redefine all-time sack list
articles.description: Myles Garrett's torrid pace up the all-time sack list paces active players making their moves among the greats.
articles.headlineJa: 現役NFL選手たちが歴代サック数記録を塗り替え続ける背景
articles.descriptionJa: マイルズ・ギャレットが歴代サック数ランキングを猛烈なペースで駆け上がっており、現役選手たちがレジェンドたちの記録に挑んでいる。
articles.body:
Last season, defensive end Myles Garrett won his second Defensive Player of the Year award after setting the NFL's single-season record with 23 sacks with the Cleveland Browns.

This season, he'll continue his climb up the NFL's all-time sack list as a member of the Los Angeles Rams after a blockbuster trade in June -- making the Rams favorites to win the Super Bowl, according to DraftKings Sportsbook, heading into the season.

Garrett entered the season with 125.5 career sacks, which was tied for 20th in NFL history and third among the other six active players -- Von Miller (No. 9), Cameron Jordan (No. 17), Calais Campbell (No. 25), T.J. Watt (No. 26), Danielle Hunter (tied for No. 27) and Khalil Mack (T-29th) -- in the top 30. 

Joining the top 30 soon could be Aaron Donald, who unretired to join Garrett on the Rams' defensive line. Donald's 111 sacks currently sits two behind 30th. 

As for Garrett, he entered his 10th season in the NFL averaging approximately 14 sacks per season. If he were to replicate that production, he would tie Pro Football Hall of Famer Jason Taylor, who currently sits at No. 7. If Garrett were to have another historic season, he would surpass Michael Strahan (No. 6) and approach career top-five territory.

Miller, who signed with the Dallas Cowboys in August, can also pass Strahan in his 15th season -- as he sits only three sacks behind him.  

But Garrett's 125.5 career sacks heading into the season was 10.5 more than any other player since his rookie season in 2017, according to ESPN Research. The pass rusher recorded at least 14 sacks in each of the past five seasons, the longest such streak by any player since 1982.

If Garrett has 18.5 or more sacks this season, he will hold the record for the most over a two-season span since 1982, according to ESPN Research, and his current ascension up the career list ranks as the second-fastest pace among the top five all time behind only Reggie White's. 

As we look at how the sack list is redefined this season, we'll highlight milestones across the NFL landscape

We will update this file as the active players move up, and we'll add nuggets and milestones throughout the season.

Week 4 update

Watt kicked off things in Week 4 on "Thursday Night Football" in an impactful way. He had one sack, one forced fumble and a fumble recovery to move his total to 4.5 sacks on the season. Other than that, there wasn't much activity with Garrett continuing to be on IR. 

Week 3 update

There wasn't much movement on the list this week with only Mack (1) and Hunter (.5) recording sacks. Watt, Campbell, Hunter and Mack (in that order) now make up 25 to 28 on the all-time list. Along with Campbell, the three top active leaders -- Miller, Jordan and Garrett -- have yet to record a sack this season.  

Week 2 update

The second week of the season saw little movement near the top of the career list, but Watt's hot start continues, with the defensive end recording 1.5 sacks to now put him at 3.5 t

articles.headline: Vikings make history at 4-0 -- without a scoring offense
articles.description: Minnesota sits atop the NFC North despite its special teams outscoring its offense the past three weeks.
articles.headlineJa: バイキングスが4勝0敗で歴史的快挙、しかし得点源は攻撃陣ではない
articles.descriptionJa: ミネソタは過去3週間にわたりスペシャルチームの得点が攻撃陣を上回っているが、NFC北地区の首位に君臨している。
articles.body:
MINNEAPOLIS -- The Minnesota Vikings are 4-0, one of three teams in the NFL without a loss, and they've gone about it in a way the league hasn't seen for more than 100 years. 

Sunday's 15-10 victory over the Miami Dolphins was the Vikings' second game this season without a touchdown. The other was a 9-3 victory in Week 2 at the Chicago Bears. 

The last time an NFL team started its season 4-0 despite having multiple games without a touchdown was in 1923. The only other time it has ever happened was in 1922, in both cases by the Chicago Cardinals. 

No team would realistically expect to be undefeated over such a stretch, but the explanation for the Vikings' success is clear. Their defense has limited opponents to an NFL-best 12.8 points per game this season and, over the past three weeks, their special teams is responsible for six times more points (42) than their offense (7). 

That formula hardly seems sustainable, but under coach Kevin O'Connell, the Vikings have demonstrated a knack for stacking wins in unusual and sometimes unprecedented ways. 

"We've got to own our role in our own aspect of not moving the football more consistently," O'Connell said, "and then go from there. But excited to get back to work at it. Excited to be 4-0 as a team."

In 2022 the Vikings set an NFL record by going 11-0 in one-score games and became the first team ever to win 13 or more games despite having a negative point differential. They have now put together an NFL-best nine-game regular-season winning streak, dating back to Week 14 of the 2025 season, despite averaging 272.8 yards per game, fourth-lowest in the NFL over that period. 

This season's team has had a level of personnel shuffle that merits appropriate context. New quarterback Kyler Murray suffered a concussion on the 11th play of the season, and receiver Justin Jefferson sprained his left ankle seven plays into Murray's return in Week 3. In other words, they have played only 18 snaps together this season. 

Sunday, they played almost half of the game without left tackle Christian Darrisaw (neck/concussion exam) and left guard Donovan Jackson (knee). In addition, the offense still appears to be adjusting to Murray, who took roughly half of the team's offensive snaps in spring practices and the first portion of training camp while competing for the job with J.J. McCarthy, who was traded to the New York Giants last Monday. 

Right tackle Brian O'Neill said last week that linemen wouldn't have "internal clocks" any longer because of the way Murray can extend plays out of the pocket. The Dolphins sacked Murray three times in the first half Sunday, Miami's first three sacks of the season, and by halftime the crowd at U.S. Bank Stadium was booing the offense with vigor. All told, the Vikings committed five pre-snap penalties on offense, including two false starts, and O'Connell noted there "were some cadence things going on that we have to continue to figure out what the root of that is."

articles.headline: Behind the scenes inside LeBron's first 76ers training camp
articles.description: From on-court schemes to a private team dinner to an attempt at divine intervention, here's what happened in LeBron's first camp with the 76ers.
articles.headlineJa: レブロン、76ersでの初トレーニングキャンプの舞台裏
articles.descriptionJa: コート上の戦術からチームのプライベートディナー、さらには神への祈りに至るまで、レブロンが76ersで過ごした初のキャンプで何が起きたのかを詳報する。
articles.body:
There might not be a more intriguing new-look team in the NBA this season than the Philadelphia 76ers.

It's not just the infusion of talent, but the rarity of the circumstances to acquire it that makes the Sixers so fascinating.

In any other year, signing forward Dean Wade to a four-year, $39 million contract and guard Anfernee Simons to a two-year, $12.3 million deal could be seen as a successful summer for a team coming off a second-round playoff appearance.

But then to trade for five-time All-Star Jaylen Brown two years after he led the Boston Celtics to the championship, making him just one of seven players in league history to change teams within two years of being named Finals MVP, made it an extraordinary offseason.

And adding LeBron James on a veteran's minimum contract made it potentially transformational.

With the Sixers playing their first preseason game Monday against the defending-champion New York Knicks, here are five key moments that have shaped their first week in training camp.

Monday, Sept. 28: four on the floor ... and a fifth in the group chat

Hours before media day opened with players posing for portraits and answering questions from local media members, the Sixers' four stars gathered on the practice floor.

They changed into their full uniforms later to be ready for photos. Their first order of business was a workout, not only to talk about, but demonstrate, how they can help one another.

All four had varying experience playing together, with Brown recently joining James and Tyrese Maxey for a few of their customary summer workouts in Los Angeles, and James playing with Joel Embiid on Team USA in 2024. But these first actions on the floor were tangible examples of the sacrifices this group has said it is willing to make for this season to be a success.

"Worked on getting to know each other," one team source told ESPN. "Camaraderie, rhythm, cadence and playing with each other."

With 36 All-Star appearances among them, each player has a game that commands extra attention from opposing defenses.

Philadelphia intends to exploit that by having its foursome work on two-man plays for when defenses inevitably overcommit.

"All four of those guys are going to be trapped somehow during the game, whether it's in the post or on the wing," the source continued. "We worked a lot on passing out of the post, making the extra pass to the corner."

Second-year guard VJ Edgecombe, the fifth starter on the team, was not part of these exercises, but there have been early indicators that he'll be included, too.

Edgecombe took it upon himself to start a group chat this summer for James and his new Sixers teammates.

"Before 'Bron got [here], I was like, 'Yo, I'm making a group chat: Me, 'Rese, JB, Joel,'" Edgecombe said of his initial plan he shared with Maxey. articles.description: Which Week 5 lines offered immediate value once odds came out? Here are four early bets we like.
articles.headlineJa: NFL第5週の早期ベット：オッズが変動する前に狙いたい3試合
articles.descriptionJa: 第5週のラインの中で、オッズ発表直後に即座に価値があったものはどれか？おすすめの4つの早期ベットを紹介します。
articles.body:
The New Orleans Saints host the Atlanta Falcons on "Monday Night Football" (8:15 p.m. ET on ESPN) to close out Week 4, but we're already looking ahead to Week 5. Which games grabbed our analysts' attention?

The surprising Cleveland Browns, winners of three straight, will try to continue their hot start on the road against the New York Jets.

The New England Patriots, fresh off an upset of the Buffalo Bills, host the Las Vegas Raiders, who suffered their first defeat in Week 4.

The New York Giants knocked off the Arizona Cardinals in Week 4 to move to 3-1 atop the NFC East and will travel to face the division rival Washington Commanders.

Who do we like? Matt Bowen, Pamela Maldonado and Seth Walder break down the games and share the bets they're backing before potential odds shifts later in the week.

Note: Odds by DraftKings  and subject to change.

Check out the latest Super Bowl odds and major NFL awards futures.

 Cleveland Browns +2.5 at New York Jets

Bowen: I expect head coach Todd Monken to lead with running back Quinshon Judkins. Downhill schemes, control tempo -- and take shots in the pass game. Cleveland can create explosive plays on the perimeter. Take the points here, as the Cleveland defense limits Geno Smith.

Last week: Cowboys +2.5 (Result: Cowboys 34, Texans 30)

 Las Vegas Raiders at New England Patriots total UNDER 45

Maldonado: The Raiders are allowing 5.2 yards per carry, giving Rhamondre Stevenson and TreVeyon Henderson a chance to move the chains and burn clock while taking pressure off Drake Maye. Vegas' run game hasn't offered much, putting more on Kirk Cousins against a Patriots defense that has been tough to throw against. Neither offense plays with much urgency between snaps, and New England struggles on third down.

Last week: Jaguars-Bengals OVER 51 (Result: Jaguars 22, Bengals 17)

 Washington Commanders -3 vs. New York Giants

Walder: I'm just speculating, but I'm guessing there's a decent chance Jayden Daniels returns for Sunday's contest, especially after Marcus Mariota was injured and knocked out of Week 4's 30-13 loss to the Indianapolis Colts. If so, I imagine this early spread will look like a value.

I also think that we shouldn't put too much stock in the Commanders' offensive struggles in London, considering they had to put third-string QB Athan Kaliakmanis into action midgame. But there were some positive signs elsewhere: Washington recorded the highest pass block win rate and second-highest pass rush win rate in Week 4 entering "Sunday Night Football." Plus, no matter who starts at quarterback for Washington, we know they'll be going against a backup in Jameis Winston.

Last week: Dolphins +10.5 (Result: Vikings 15, Dolphins 10)

articles.headline: How a mass Man City player exodus would warp the transfer market
articles.description: If Manchester City are punished by being relegated from the Premier League, group of players worth more than £1 billion in transfer fees would suddenly become available.
articles.headlineJa: マンチェスター・シティ選手の大量流出が移籍市場をどう激変させるか
articles.descriptionJa: もしマンチェスター・シティが罰則としてプレミアリーグから降格することになれば、総額10億ポンド以上の価値がある選手たちが突如として移籍市場に放出されることになる。
articles.body:
What would happen to the transfer market if a group of players worth over £1 billion suddenly became available in the same window, all anxious to immediately find a new club?

If Manchester City fail to overturn an independent commission finding that they were guilty of all charges related to serious breaches of the Premier League's financial rules over a nine-season period -- City reject the findings and lodged their appeal on Oct. 2 -- the soccer world will find out exactly what it looks like when a collection of superstars and serial winners flood the market.

It would be a football version of "Supermarket Sweep" with Europe's biggest clubs raiding the Etihad Stadium for cut-price deals. With few exceptions, players would be ready to take the first opportunity to escape the crumbling empire they were once so desperate join.

But it would also distort the market more than any previous situation. Chelsea super-charged the transfer market when Russian oligarch Roman Abramovich funded their high spending in the mid-2000s. City took it to another level following Sheikh Mansour bin Zayed al Nahyan's takeover in 2008 -- that spending is the root of the problems they now find themselves in with the Premier League. But if the exit doors are forced open at the Etihad, it will drive transfer fees down and change the whole landscape of the market.

With Premier League CEO Richard Masters saying last week that City "systematically broke Premier League rules for nearly a decade," the likelihood is high of tough sanctions on the club if their appeal fails. Potential punishments include expulsion from the league -- City could be kicked out and forced to apply to rejoin at the bottom of the English football pyramid -- or a huge points deduction that would make relegation to the second-tier Championship unavoidable.

That outcome -- dropping down just one division -- might prove to be the best-case scenario for City. But don't be fooled into believing that the club would be able to ride it out, keep their squad intact and seal an instant return to the top division.

The financial implications of dropping out of the Premier League, and the Champions League, would be seismic even for a club of City's stature and the inevitable outcome would be a mass exodus of their high-earning players.

Championship clubs receive just £5.7 million a year from the EFL's broadcast deal. Last season, City banked £248.9 million in prize money (£165.5 million from the Premier League, £83.4 million from the Champions League), so a hole of more than £240 million would immediately appear in their finances.

City's most recently published wage bill, for the 2024-25 season, amounted to £408.4 million. It is now likely to be closer to an annual £450 million following the arrivals of players including Gianluigi Donnarumma, Rayan Cherki, Antoine Semenyo, Marc Guéhi, Elliot Anderson and Enzo Fernández.

articles.headline: Ledley King backs Tottenham form to 'turn around very quickly'
articles.description: Ledley King has urged Roberto De Zerbi's team to draw on the experiences of last season to end the club's winless start to the new Premier League campaign.
articles.headlineJa: レドリー・キング、トッテナムの調子は「すぐに好転する」と支持
articles.descriptionJa: レドリー・キングは、ロベルト・デ・ゼルビ率いるチームに対し、昨シーズンの経験を活かして、プレミアリーグ新シーズンでの勝ちなしスタートから脱却するよう促した。
articles.body:
Former Tottenham captain Ledley King has urged Roberto De Zerbi's team to draw on the experiences of last season to end the club's winless start to the new Premier League campaign.

Spurs have been bottom of the table since a 3-2 loss at home to Aston Villa on Sept. 19, which made it two points from five league matches.

After a summer of lavish spending following successive 17th-placed finishes, expectations were raised, but League Cup winner King believes one positive result can act as a catalyst for Tottenham to turn around their form.

The situation was far more bleak for Spurs in March when De Zerbi arrived in north London with the singular focus to avoid a catastrophic relegation to the Championship.

Even though confidence was at an all-time low, De Zerbi masterminded survival after a 15-match winless run in the division was snapped and King believes that experience can help before Saturday's trip to Manchester United.

"It's been tough at the moment, but you can see signs of improvement game by game," King said at a recent Hall of Fame event at Tottenham Hotspur Stadium.

"[They have] no choice. You have to find a way. Most of the group have gone through difficult periods and they managed to find a way out last season.

"They'll have to draw on that to a certain degree, but there is no easy way. You keep working on the training pitch, keep putting the work in.

"It's just a confidence thing. These are top players. I'm sure once the first positive result goes for the team, things can turn around very quickly. Just keep working hard, keep believing in yourself. That's the only way to do it."

- Andrew Robertson after hitting 100 Scotland caps: Hopefully I can catch Kenny Dalglish

- Roberto De Zerbi receives backing of Tottenham's chief executive

- Jan Paul van Hecke returns to Tottenham after suffering foot injury with Netherlands

Former England centre back King spent his entire career at Tottenham and made 323 appearances despite a long-standing knee injury.

King etched his name into club folklore with League Cup success in 2008 and as captain during Spurs' first venture into the Champions League two years later.

After the 45-year-old was one of four people inducted into the relaunched Hall of Fame last month, he received a thunderous reception as a half-time guest for the Villa match.

King said: "To be in the Hall of Fame is really humbling."

articles.headline: Folarin Balogun reopens door to Premier League despite failed Everton move
articles.description: United States striker Folarin Balogun has said that he would still be keen to play in the Premier League, even though his transfer deadline day move to Everton collapsed in dramatic fashion.
articles.headlineJa: フォラリン・バログン、エバートンへの移籍失敗後もプレミアリーグ復帰に意欲
articles.descriptionJa: アメリカ代表ストライカーのフォラリン・バログンは、移籍期限最終日にエバートンへの移籍が劇的な形で崩れたものの、依然としてプレミアリーグでのプレーに意欲的であると語った。
articles.body:
United States striker Folarin Balogun has said that he would still be keen to play in the Premier League, even though his transfer deadline day move to Everton collapsed in dramatic fashion.

Balogun, 25, backed out of a move to the Toffees after Everton and Monaco started to restructure the terms of his transfer after issues were raised during the his medical examination at Everton's Finch Farm training ground.

Asked by talkSPORT if a Premier League move is something that he'd still be interested in, Balogun said: "Yes, potentially.

"Football has many twists and turns as we've seen after the World Cup.

"I was close to a transfer, didn't materialise, but for sure it's definitely an option."

Monaco sporting director Thiago Scuro said at the time that Balogun abandoned the move due to concerns over his treatment by the Merseyside club.

The former Arsenal forward continues to play his football at Monaco, after a high-profile summer in which he put in some solid performances for the USMNT at the World Cup but also found himself the subject of a major controversy.

Balogun picked up a red card against Bosnia and Herzegovina in the round of 32 and was subsequently banned from the USMNT's round of 16 clash with Belgium.

But then, the red card and ban were overturned by FIFA after U.S. President Donald Trump asked FIFA chief Gianni Infantino to review the decision.

Infantino said the decision was not influenced by Trump. Balogun was handed a suspended ban that allowed him to play against Belgium, but the UMSNT lost and were eliminated from the tournament.

- Folarin Balogun red card U-turn 'most serious incident in the history of football' - LaLiga boss

- Pochettino shares 'regret' over Balogun controversy, impact on USMNT

- David Moyes vents over Everton transfer window after Folarin Balogun deal collapse

Monaco are flying high in Ligue 1 and currently sit at the top of the table after five games, five points ahead of reigning champions Paris Saint-Germain.

Balogun's first match back for Monaco after the summer's transfer debacle was against Lens. Monaco won 2-1.

articles.headline: Premier League injury concerns from the international break
articles.description: All the latest news and updates on Premier League stars injuries during the first international break of the 2026-2027 club season
articles.headlineJa: 代表ウィークによるプレミアリーグの負傷者への懸念
articles.descriptionJa: 2026-2027クラブシーズンの最初の代表ウィーク中に発生した、プレミアリーグのスター選手たちの負傷に関する最新ニュースとアップデート。
articles.body:
Premier League teams will be watching and hoping their star players remain healthy throughout the international break.

However, some have already sustained injuries while playing for their countries. Premier League matches resume on Oct. 10.

ESPN will be tracking the latest injuries and updates for your club's players:

Kai Havertz (Arsenal)

Arsenal's Kai Havertz was forced off in the 30th minute of the game between Netherlands and Germany on September 24th with what was described as a muscle injury.

"Both are currently undergoing an MRI," Jurgen Klopp said on RTL about Havertz and Jamal Musiala. "I hope we get the diagnosis [on Thursday] evening. But of course, this isn't great. I hope it's nothing serious. The lads are probably out for us. But hopefully, they'll be back in action relatively quickly."

On September 25 the German Football Association confirmed the attacker would be leaving Klopp's camp and return to Arsenal after suffering what they describe as a 'muscle strain.'

Brian Brobbey (Sunderland)

The powerful Sunderland attacker was also injured in the same game after picking up what looked like a hamstring injury while running for the ball. He immediately went down and signalled to the sideline.

He left the field of his own accord but did have a heavy limp as he walked down the tunnel.

Netherlands boss Xavi Hernandez said after the game: "Brian is indeed injured."

Brobbey was replaced by Joshua Zirkzee in the Dutch squad.

Zion Suzuki (Aston Villa)

The goalkeeper linked up with the Japan squad but according to reports missed the main group training session on September 22nd, according to local reports. Instead he was put on an individual session for a rib injury.

Suzuki was subsequently left out of Japan's matchday squad entirely for Thursday's 3-1 victory over Uruguay.

Dan Ballard (Sunderland)

The Sunderland defender suffered a reported hamstring injury during Northern Ireland's 1-0 victory over Georgia in the UEFA Nations League.

With the score still 0-0 as the match moved into stoppage time, Ballard chased back as Georgia counter-attacked and pulled up clutching the back of his thigh, unable to finish the match in Tbilisi.

Speaking immediately after Friday's match, manager Michael O'Neill said it was too soon to know the extent of his latest injury but will definitely miss the next three Northern Ireland games.

"We'll scan him tomorrow (Saturday), but he's certainly not going to be available for the next three games."

Alexander Isak (Liverpool)

Alexander Isak is returning to Liverpool after sustaining a "minor injury" on international duty.

The striker scored and played the full 90 minutes in Sweden's 2-1 victory over Romania in the Nations League on Friday.

But Isak, who has made a strong start to the season for Liverpool, will not feature in matches against Poland, Bosnia and Herzegovina and Romania over the remainder of the extended international break.

articles.headline: Kylian Mbappé goes cycling despite José Mourinho warning
articles.description: Kylian Mbappé has shared a video of himself riding a bicycle on social media, just days after his Real Madrid manager, José Mourinho, said players couldn't go cycling because of the injury risks involved.
articles.headlineJa: キリアン・エムバペ、ジョゼ・モウリーニョの警告を無視してサイクリングへ
articles.descriptionJa: レアル・マドリードのジョゼ・モウリーニョ監督が負傷リスクを理由に選手にサイクリングを禁じたわずか数日後、キリアン・エムバペが自身が自転車に乗る動画をSNSに投稿した。
articles.body:
Kylian Mbappé has shared a video of himself riding a bicycle on social media, just days after his Real Madrid manager, José Mourinho, said players couldn't go cycling because of the injury risks involved.

In an Instagram story posted on Sunday, Mbappé -- who is currently out of action after picking up an injury with France earlier in this international break -- filmed himself cycling, smiling and wearing a helmet, on what appeared to be a country road.

The video clip, which lasted just a few seconds and was accompanied by a 1970s song "The Good Guys, The Bad Guys" by the singer Michel Fugain, has been interpreted in the French media as a response to his critics.

Last month, Mourinho used bike riding as an example of the activities footballers must avoid, given their profession.

"You are a football player 24 hours a day," Mourinho told the Bet It Drives show. "Everything reflects the job. What you eat, what you drink, how you sleep, even things in your private life. You cannot ski. You cannot ride a bike.

"You fall off your bike, and you don't play three matches maybe, or maybe worse, maybe you break a leg ... There are a lot of things you have to give up to be a football player."

Mbappé suffered a hyperextension of his left knee during France's game with Türkiye on September 25, and was subsequently released by the national team.

ESPN has reported that his participation in Real Madrid's game with Villarreal this Saturday when LaLiga returns is in doubt, although he is expected to be fit to play Barcelona in El Clásico on Oct. 25.

- Kylian Mbappé, Ibrahima Konaté, Fede Valverde expected to be available for El Clásico - source

- Dembélé dismisses 'little squabbles' pitting him against Mbappé

- UEFA receives Real Madrid dossier on Barcelona-Negreira case

Mbappé has scored seven goals in seven league games for Madrid so far this season, but the team are already six points behind rivals Barça in the table.

He faced criticism in the Madrid media last season after being pictured on holiday on a yacht with his partner, while recovering from a hamstring injury.

articles.headline: Transfer rumors, news: Bayern brace for tough contract talks with Olise
articles.description: Bayern Munich could be facing an uphill battle to sign winger Michael Olise to a new contract. Transfer Talk has the latest.
articles.headlineJa: 移籍の噂・ニュース：バイエルン、オリセとの厳しい契約交渉に備える
articles.descriptionJa: バイエルン・ミュンヘンは、ウィングのマイケル・オリセと新契約を結ぶために苦戦を強いられる可能性がある。Transfer Talkが最新情報をお届けする。
articles.body:
Bayern Munich are bracing for tough contract talks with star winger Michael Olise, while Chelsea lead the race for AFC Bournemouth midfielder Alex Scott. Join us for the latest transfer news and rumors from around the globe.

Transfers home page | Men's summer grades | Women's grades

Trending rumors

- Bayern Munich are concerned about talks to renew Michael Olise's contract, as the winger hasn't yet told them if he even wants to stay in Bavaria, as reported by Sport Bild. The Bundesliga club is preparing for a very difficult negotiation with the representatives of the 24-year-old. One of the sticking points is that the France international wants a release clause in his new contract, something both Harry Kane and Jamal Musiala have. Bayern are willing to offer a mega contract that will run until 2032 but want an answer by next summer.

- Chelsea are leading the race to sign AFC Bournemouth midfielder Alex Scott, who is also attracting strong interest from Liverpool and Arsenal, as reported by The Telegraph. Elsewhere, TEAMtalk have suggested that Real Madrid are considering becoming involved in the race for the 23-year-old after watching him closely in recent weeks. Los Blancos have watched Scott at least three times, including his first England start in the Three Lions' 7-0 victory over Croatia.

- Italian outlet Corriere dello Sport has offered an insight into the names Roma are looking at as they aim to sign a winger. In the summer, they looked at Stuttgart's Jamie Leweling and Chelsea's Jamie Gittens, who have both had a lack of game time since the summer transfer window shut so could be available for less than was demanded before. They also want Real Madrid's Endrick, hoping for a Donyell Malen-style deal where they have a loan with the option to make it permanent, and they aren't alarmed by AC Milan's interest. Frosinone's Giorgi Kvernadze is another player of interest.

- Juventus see Marseille midfielder Pierre-Emile Højbjerg as the leader Luciano Spalletti needs, as reported by La Gazzetta dello Sport. They have previously looked at Leon Goretzka and Franck Kessié, who ended up at Aston Villa and Atalanta respectively, but remain keen on signing an older head for their midfield so are turning to the man who is captain for both Marseille and Denmark. There have already been exploratory contacts made about the 31-year-old, while Teun Koopmeiners is the main candidate to leave so he can come in.

- Juventus have recently made a move for Frosinone goalkeeper Lorenzo Palmisani and Inter Milan are monitoring him, as reported by La Gazzetta dello Sport. Inter chief executive Beppe Marotta has insisted on a mix of foreign and Italian players, emphasizing the importance of a strong Italy squad. I Nerazzurri could decide to loan out the 22-year-old if they sign him, and they are also looking at Alessandro Romano, who is on loan at Cagliari from Roma.

articles.headline: Pistons' Jalen Duren happy to return despite prolonged talks
articles.description: Despite a prolonged negotiation that appeared to turn sour at times, Jalen Duren said he is relieved and excited to return to Detroit.
articles.headlineJa: ピストンズのジェイレン・デュレン、長期にわたる交渉を経て復帰を喜ぶ
articles.descriptionJa: 時には険悪なムードに陥った長期の交渉を経て、ジェイレン・デュレンはデトロイトに復帰できることに安堵と喜びを感じていると語った。
articles.body:
Jalen Duren was both relieved and excited after signing a new five-year, $200 million deal to return to the Detroit Pistons after a contract negotiation that he said took "longer than both he and the organization anticipated."

But during his first news conference after signing his new deal, he wanted to clarify narratives that emerged during the negotiation that he said did not represent how he felt about the team, repeating that he was happy in Detroit and excited to return to the team.

"Detroit has become a home for me, this is where I live full-time," Duren told reporters at the team's practice facility on Sunday afternoon. "The city has embraced me as well as I've embraced the city.

"This process took way longer than any of us really wanted. Longer than I wanted, and I'm sure longer than the organization wanted. But [the Pistons] have a job to do as well as my team and my agency have a job to do to make the best outcome for both sides. I feel like we've done that."

 

Duren missed media day and the first few practices of training camp this week after a four-month long standoff between he and the Pistons over the value of his new contract. They eventually came to an agreement on a fully guaranteed contract late Thursday night, ahead of the deadline for him to accept a one-year qualifying offer.

On Sunday, sitting next to team president of basketball operations Trajan Langdon, Duren said he wanted to be in Detroit for the rest of his career.

"There's a business component that it took me time to realize and understand because this is my first time going through it," the 22-year old All-NBA center said. "I can admit that I have flaws. We all do and we're here to work on it.

"I don't think this should be a negative outlook or looked at as something bad has happened. I think we look at it as something great has happened. I'm locked in with a team and a core who has potential that's going through the roof and I'm super excited for what's to come."

The standoff over Duren's contract came following the best regular season of the young center's career. He averaged a career high in points (19.5), made his first All-Star team and was named to the All-NBA third team as the Pistons became the top seed in the Eastern Conference. But he struggled mightily in the postseason, dropping to 10.2 points per game in 14 playoff games before Detroit's second-round exit.

Duren said he took a step back to get his head right following a postseason he described as "humbling," and he acknowledged his own silence allowed narratives to emerge in his absence. But he said he stayed focused in the offseason on getting better and acknowledging his flaws.

"Last season was some of my highest moments in my career and some of my lowest," Duren said. "I'm willing to acknowledge that. articles.headline: Spurs' Tobias Harris to miss preseason with left calf strain
articles.description: Spurs free agent acquisition Tobias Harris sustained a calf strain during camp that has him questionable for the team's Oct. 20 season opener vs. OKC.
articles.headlineJa: スパーズのトバイアス・ハリス、左ふくらはぎの挫傷でプレシーズンを欠場
articles.descriptionJa: スパーズがフリーエージェントで獲得したトバイアス・ハリスが、キャンプ中にふくらはぎを挫傷。10月20日のOKC戦でのシーズン開幕戦への出場は不透明となっている。
articles.body:
SAN ANTONIO -- The San Antonio Spurs announced before tipoff of their intrasquad scrimmage Sunday that free-agent acquisition Tobias Harris suffered a strained left calf during training camp that leaves him questionable for the Oct. 20 season opener against Oklahoma City.

A teams spokesman said that Harris would miss Sunday's scrimmage and will be re-evaluated after the preseason.

Harris, 34, signed a two-year, $31 million deal in July to join the Spurs, leaving a Detroit Pistons team that he helped lead a franchise turnaround over the previous two seasons.

A productive veteran lauded for knocking down shots and floor spacing in the frontcourt, Harris was expected to begin the season in San Antonio's starting lineup.

Harris averaged 13.5 points and 5.6 rebounds per game in his second stint in Detroit, as the Pistons improved from one of the league's worst teams two years ago to capturing 60 victories last season and advancing in the playoffs for the first time since 2008.

Harris served as one of the few veterans on a Pistons team that ranked as one of the NBA's youngest. The veteran signed a two-year $52 million deal with Detroit in 2024 as a free agency, after spending six seasons with the Philadelphia 76ers.

articles.headline: Transfer rumors, news: Arsenal among clubs chasing winger Yildiz
articles.description: Arsenal, Real Madrid and Bayern Munich are all chasing Juventus winger Kenan Yildiz. Transfer Talk has the latest.
articles.headlineJa: 移籍の噂・ニュース：ウィングのユルディズ獲得を目指すクラブの中にアーセナルも
articles.descriptionJa: アーセナル、レアル・マドリード、バイエルン・ミュンヘンが、ユヴェントスのウィング、ケナン・ユルディズの獲得を争っている。最新の移籍情報をお届けする。
articles.body:
Arsenal, Real Madrid and Bayern Munich are all chasing Juventus winger Kenan Yildiz. Plus, could Endrick leave Real Madrid for AC Milan?

Join us for the latest transfer news and rumors from around the globe.

Transfers home page | Men's summer grades | Women's grades

Trending rumors

- Real Madrid are pushing for Kenan Yildiz with Arsenal and Bayern Munich also looking at the Juventus winger, reports Corriere dello Sport. Juve have been demanding at least €100 million for the 21-year-old for a year, but Madrid are reigniting their interest in him with the view to a move in the summer. They would want to pit him and Vinícius Júnior against each other, while Arsenal see the Turkiye international as the answer to their lack of options on the left and Bayern have been watching him from afar since his departure.

- AC Milan are planning to make another attempt to sign Real Madrid striker Endrick after being unable to bring him in during the summer, reports La Gazzetta dello Sport. Madrid boss Jose Mourinho had initially refused to let the 20-year-old leave, but he has made just one substitute appearance this season that lasted four minutes. Milan's main competition from within Italy for the Brazil international is Roma, while Aston Villa were also unsuccessful in their efforts to bring him in last summer.

- Barcelona are willing to let Alejandro Balde leave on loan in January with Manchester United among the clubs interested in the left-back, according to TEAMtalk. The 22-year-old has fallen down the pecking order in Hansi Flick's squad and has only got onto the pitch once so far this season, playing the last 12 minutes in a 7-2 win over Racing Santander. The Spaniard's camp and intermediaries are already working hard to find a solution for him, while the Blaugrana could look to bring in a new left-back in 2027.

- Liverpool center back Giovanni Leoni is the latest name La Gazzetta dello Sport have linked with Juventus, as I Bianconeri aim to introduce young Italian talent to their squad. The Serie A side have turned their attention away from the likes of Arsenal's Riccardo Calafiori and Chelsea's Marco Palestra, who are now seen as unattainable, and had already made enquiries about a loan for Leoni in recent months. Liverpool haven't opened the door to the 19-year-old leaving, but Juventus aren't giving up on him.

- Barcelona are interested in 18-year-old FC Twente center back Ruud Nijstad, reports transfer journalist Fabrizio Romano. They are monitoring the young Dutchman, having already made contact about him in August but ultimately being told that a transfer wasn't possible as Twente wanted him to be a key player for them. More clubs are showing an interest in Nijstad and have started travelling to scout him.

- Real Madrid are among the clubs who could move to sign Manchester United attacker JJ Gabriel, according to Spanish newspaper AS. Various clubs across Europe are looking at the 15-year-old after it was made clear that he wants to leave

articles.headline: Lakers' Ziaire Williams proposes to longtime girlfriend at Bruno Mars tour
articles.description: The singer complemented the proposal during his second of five Inglewood shows.
articles.headlineJa: レイカーズのザイア・ウィリアムズ、ブルーノ・マーズのツアーで長年の恋人にプロポーズ
articles.descriptionJa: イングルウッドでの5公演のうち2公演目、歌手のブルーノ・マーズがこのプロポーズを盛り上げた。
articles.body:
Pop superstar Bruno Mars knows how to put on a good show. But on Friday night, one audience member seemed to steal the show from the 16-time Grammy winner.

As Mars performed "Marry You" during his second night of five in Inglewood, California, for "The Romantic Tour," Los Angeles Lakers forward Ziaire Williams found the perfect moment to make a promise for forever.

On the floor level of SoFi Stadium, Williams got down on bended knee as Mars sang the words "I think I wanna marry you," lining up his question -- "Will you marry me?" -- with the lyrics.

As Williams proposed to his teary-eyed girlfriend, model Paris Timan, Mars blended his singing with his excitement, crooning, "Please say I do I do I do."

After Timan -- who seemed to be in shock -- said yes, Mars continued singing through the song's conclusion while the couple shared a hug as the audience erupted in cheers.

Timan will be part of two new beginnings for Williams. In July, the 25-year-old signed a one-year, $3 million deal with the Lakers after a 2025-26 season in which he posted 10.2 points and 2.4 rebounds per game in 54 games with the Brooklyn Nets.

And the next part? Planning the rest of their lives together. Nothing screams "fairy tale" more than a proposal to a Mars love song.
